header.running_head: Propagating one's Knowledge even if One does not practise and Seeking Protection from Knowledge that is not Beneficial

blocks.text: Statements of Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Mas'ood (RA) and Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Abbaas (RA) Concerning the Lifting of Knowledge and the Statement Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Abbaas (RA) made when Hadhrat Zaid (RA) passed away

Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Mas'ood (RA) once asked, "Do you know how Islaam will dwindle?" The people replied, "Just as the dye on clothing fades or as an animal loses its fat or as a Dirham deteriorates when it is hidden away for too long." Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Mas'ood (RA) replied, "That also happens, but the most serious cause will be the death of the Ulema." [^1]

Hadhrat Sa'eed bin Musayyib says, "I attended the funeral of Hadhrat Zaid bin Thaabit (RA). After he had been buried, Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Abbaas (RA) said, "O you people! Whoever wishes to know how knowledge leaves us, should know that it is like this that knowledge leaves. I swear by Allaah that a great deal of knowledge has just left us today." [^2]

Hadhrat Ammaar bin Abu Ammaar says, "When Hadhrat Zaid bin Thaabit (RA) passed away, we sat with Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Abbaas (RA) in the shade of a building. He said, "It is like this that knowledge leaves. A great deal of knowledge has just been buried today." Another narration states that as he pointed his finger to the grave, Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Abbaas (RA) said, "It is like this that knowledge leaves. When a man passes away who knows something that no one else knows, his knowledge leaves with him."
Yet another narration states that Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Abbaas (RA) once asked, "Do you know how knowledge will leave? It is by the Ulema leaving the surface of the earth." [^3]
Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Mas'ood (RA) said, "I strongly believe that it is by committing sins that a man forgets the knowledge he once learnt." [^4]
Hadhrat Qaasim reports that Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Mas'ood (RA) said, "The problem with knowledge is forgetting." [^5]
